_quoi: Les deux référentiels du groupe « Données & Partage » : le DGA (règlement (UE) 2022/868) et le Data Act (règlement (UE) 2023/2854). Ce que les routes /api/dga/referentiel et /api/data-act/referentiel servent, ce que les sept écrans peignent, et les libellés du rail. La terminologie est celle des versions anglaises officielles des deux règlements : data holder, data recipient, connected product, related service, data intermediation services, data altruism, re-user, switching, functional equivalence, rulebook, exceptional need. LES DEUX FLÈCHES DU RAIL N'Y SONT PAS, ET C'EST VOULU : « ↓ DGA — qualification » et « ↓ Data Act — qualification » sont servies par le motif « ↓ {} » de motifs.json, qui recopie le nom du bloc — et le nom anglais de l'onglet est fait des mêmes mots. Une entrée littérale serait refusée comme « identique au français », et elle le mériterait : elle ne traduirait rien.

texte.Aucune des pratiques interdites par le §: None of the practices prohibited by §#: a non-neutral interface, profiling not agreed upon, passing the data to another third party, use to develop a competing product, turning the data against the user's economic position

texte.Infrastructure, plateforme ou logiciel e: Infrastructure, platform or software as a service, provided to customers in the Union, whatever your place of establishment.

texte.L'article # renvoie aux États membres le: Article # refers the penalty regime to the Member States, with NO European cap — unlike the Data Act, which borrows the one in Article #(#) GDPR. Financial exposure is read in national law.
texte.L'article # §# charge les États membres: Article #(#) tasks the Member States with laying down the penalty regime and states no amount, neither in euros nor as a share of turnover. Unlike the Data Act, which borrows from Article #(#) GDPR, the DGA lends no European cap: exposure is read in national law.
texte.L'article #er §# dit que le RGPD prévaut: Article #(#) says that the GDPR prevails in the event of a conflict and that the DGA creates NO legal basis for processing: falling under the DGA does not dispense with Article #.
texte.L'autorité peut percevoir une redevance: The authority may charge a proportionate fee. For SMEs and start-ups, it may reduce it or waive it (§#).
texte.L'empêcher d'obtenir une copie des donné: Preventing it from obtaining a copy of the data it provided or generated, during the contract or within a reasonable period afterwards
texte.L'empêcher de résilier l'accord dans un: Preventing it from terminating the agreement within a reasonable period
texte.L'exemption de l'article # ne couvre que: The exemption of Article # covers only Chapter II, and subject to conditions. An SME remains bound by Chapters IV, VI and VII.
texte.L'exemption ne vaut QUE pour le chapitre: The exemption holds ONLY for Chapter II. The unfair terms of Chapter IV, the switching of Chapter VI and the international access of Chapter VII know nothing of it.
texte.L'exposition financière n'est pas chiffr: Financial exposure cannot be quantified here: Article # refers it to national law, with no European cap.
texte.L'obligation de l'article # §# — accessi: The obligation of Article #(#) — data accessibility by design — applies to connected products and related services placed on the market after that date.
texte.L'échange se fait au format reçu ; toute: Exchange takes place in the format received; any conversion is justified and opens an opt-out, unless Union law requires it.
texte.L'échéance transitoire de l'article # es: The transitional deadline of Article # passed on # September #. A provider that was already supplying data intermediation services on # June # and has not notified is not behind a timetable: it is in breach.
texte.La CNIL garde ses pouvoirs sur les trait: The CNIL retains its powers over the personal data processing of an intermediary or of a data altruism organisation.
texte.La Commission tient un registre public d: The Commission maintains a public register of all providers offering their services in the Union (§#).
texte.La cessation d'activité est notifiée dan: The cessation of activity is notified within fifteen days (§#).
texte.La compensation convenue est non discrim: The agreed compensation is non-discriminatory and reasonable; where the counterpart is an SME or a not-for-profit research organisation, it does not exceed the costs directly related
texte.La compensation due au détenteur est ver: The compensation due to the data holder is paid in accordance with Article #, and gratuity is invoked only in the cases it provides for
texte.La demande est motivée, proportionnée, p: The request is reasoned, proportionate, specific as to the data, the purpose and the duration, and published online without delay
texte.La notification a été soumise à l'autori: The notification was submitted to the competent authority before the service was provided
texte.La notification préalable de l'article #: The prior notification of Article # and the fifteen conditions of Article #, under the supervision of a competent authority.
texte.La vérification de la qualité d'utilisat: Verification that a person is a user requires only the necessary information, and no connection data is retained beyond what is necessary

texte.Laquelle ou lesquelles des sept qualités: Which one or more of the seven capacities of Article #(#) are yours? They apply WHATEVER your place of establishment.

texte.Le Data Act ne prévoit ni certification: The Data Act provides for neither certification nor marking. A high rate here carries no presumption of conformity.

texte.Le détenteur est informé sans retard de: The data holder is informed without delay of any unauthorised transfer of, access to or use of the non-personal data shared.

texte.Le label de l'article # §# s'obtient de: The label of Article #(#) is obtained from the competent authority upon confirmation, never from a questionnaire. This module prepares the file; it does not issue the label.

texte.Le règlement NE CRÉE PAS de base juridiq: The Regulation DOES NOT CREATE a legal basis for the processing of personal data, and does not alter the rights and obligations of the GDPR.
